newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's Perez downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's Perez downgraded.

text.p: Ing Barings said Tuesday it was downgrading Argentine conglomerate Perez Companc to hold from buy.

Analyst Kathleen Breitenbach wrote in a report that the firm set for Perez a price target of $9.00 per local share ($18.00 per ADR), implying a total appreciation of 10 percent over the next 12 months.
"According to our breakdown by business valuation the stock is trading at 16-25 percent premium, what we feel is a rich valuation," she said.
"We are still positive about the company fundamentals; however, we do not anticipate market outperformance over the next 12 months, given the stock's rich valuation and our expected lower earnings."
